meta.title: Chennai new domestic water connection grid-only evidence ledger
meta.disclaimer: Independent research, not official advice. Grid-only benchmark run: sources and claims only, no nodes, edges, roadblocks or journeys. Desk research, no counter visited. Limitations: the application form and the online application portal were read but never filled in or submitted, and the application-status route was read but never queried; the board's tariff revision route publishes a board resolution stating percentage increases rather than a revised schedule of amounts, so the connection charges recorded here come from the application form's own table; the board's older host chennaimetrowater.tn.gov.in did not connect on the access date and the working host is cmwssb.tn.gov.in; three of the five source URLs have no Wayback snapshot. Do not submit personal data through this ledger.

agencies.name: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board

scenarios.label: Chennai new domestic water connection
scenarios.summary: The individual owner of a built residential property with no connection applies to the city's water utility for a new domestic water supply, with sewer only where the same application covers it. Bulk or high-rise connections, commercial use, regularisation of unauthorised connections, name transfer on an existing account and tanker supply are excluded.

claims.text: The board's citizen charter states that for the revised online route the consumer must first create an applicant login using a mobile number, email id and password before applying for a water or sewer connection.
claims.notes: Boundary statement, recorded as a limitation and not used to support any positive cell value. Basis boundary as required by protocol section 5: the observed element is the citizen charter's own text stating that the consumer must first create an applicant login with a mobile number, email id and password before applying on the revised online route; the inferred element is the reading that the counter route needs no login and is where the published charges, enclosures and timelines apply, which is drawn from the application form's counter registration instructions rather than stated as such by either source. Nothing behind the login was observed: no login was used, no account was created and no personal data was entered.

claims.text: The deposit amounts for water and for sewer that the application form requires the applicant to compute are not established by any reviewed public page.
claims.notes: Retained because the uncertainty itself matters to the journey: the form asks the applicant to self-assess a figure the reviewed routes do not publish. Not login-related.
